description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1985/25 dated 22.09.2016 - Gampaha D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains amendments to land lot numbers, descriptions of land parcels (including land names, descriptions of contents, and extents), and details about claimants. The content is exclusively focused on land-related administrative procedures, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
